comment: Input to eng/notices.py. Every PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props must appear under 'packages', classified as 'bundled' (its code ships inside the Quantix package, so it is credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt) or 'not-distributed' (with the reason it never ships). Licence texts are copied verbatim from the source URL at the retrieval time recorded here; never edit them or the generated output by hand.

PolySharp.reason: Source generator; the polyfill types it emits are compiled into Quantix.Generator.dll (analyzers/dotnet/cs).

Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.reason: Compile-time reference only (PrivateAssets=all); the compiler host supplies it at run time.

Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.reason: Declared as a NuGet dependency; restored by the consumer from nuget.org, not redistributed inside the Quantix package.

notices.usage: Generates the polyfill types compiled into Quantix.Generator.dll.
The polyfill types compiled into Quantix.Generator.dll are .NET runtime source; each file states it is licensed to you under the MIT license by the .NET Foundation.
